:::{#def-complex-modulus}
#### Absolute value (modulus) of a complex number

The **absolute value**, or **modulus**, of a complex number $z = a + b\,i$ (@def-complex-number) is

$$\abs{z} \eqdef \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}.$$

:::

::: notes
@axler2024linear [Definition 4.2, p. 120] gives the same definition.
:::
